note: Exact set of lib/rbac exported functions with NO production caller outside lib/rbac (#2597). Shrink-only: wiring one is red until its entry comes down; a new unwired export is red outright. Each entry names the proposed consumer (Option A of #2597) that would retire it.

exports.lib/rbac/approval-workflows.ts:checkNeed: Producer half of the approval inbox: no mutating entity handler calls it, so approval_requests has no writer. Needs #2597 Option A3 (rule-matched POST hooks).
exports.lib/rbac/approval-workflows.ts:requestAp: Creates approval_requests rows; only reachable from checkNeedsApproval, itself unwired. Retired together with A3.
exports.lib/rbac/enforce.ts:__clearRoleIdCache: Test-only cache reset called from tests/unit/rbac-field-enforcement-2597.test.ts; intentionally has no production caller.
exports.lib/rbac/enforce.ts:__clearFieldRestrict: Test-only cache reset called from tests/unit/rbac-field-enforcement-2597.test.ts; intentionally has no production caller.
exports.lib/rbac/enforce.ts:getFieldRestrictions: Internal helper composed only inside lib/rbac/enforce.ts by enforceFieldRead/Write; needs no caller outside the module.
exports.lib/rbac/enforce.ts:stripRowForRead: Internal row projector composed only inside lib/rbac/enforce.ts; needs no caller outside the module.
exports.lib/rbac/field-permissions.ts:checkField: Superseded by lib/rbac/enforce.ts used in the 10 entity routes pinned by guard:field-permissions; kept for the legacy API, not called in production.
exports.lib/rbac/field-permissions.ts:filterFiel: Same legacy field-permission API as checkFieldAccess; enforcement now goes through enforceFieldRead/Write.
exports.lib/rbac/record-permissions.ts:checkReco: Legacy per-record reader taking a role id; A2's typed lib/rbac/record-scope.ts helper resolves the role from AuthContext instead. Kept for the legacy API, not called in production.
exports.lib/rbac/record-permissions.ts:getColumn: Helper for the legacy string-based filter; A2 enforces through lib/rbac/record-scope.ts, which takes Drizzle columns so joins cannot leave identifiers ambiguous.
exports.lib/rbac/record-permissions.ts:getRecord: String-identifier fragment from the competing model; superseded by getRecordGrantCondition in record-scope.ts.
